It is unknown whether maribavir or its metabolites are present in human or animal milk, their effects on milk production, or their impact on breastfed infants. Category A: Generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. The medication can be taken with or without food. Store the product at a temperature of 20-25ºC (68-77ºF), with permissible excursions to 15-30ºC (59-86ºF).
